title.zh: 查询符合条件的SAP HANA数据库

descriptions.zh: 注册SAP HANA实例且安装备份客户端后，可以调用该接口查询SAP HANA数据库信息；若要启动或停止数据库，可分别调用StartHanaDatabaseAsync和StopHanaDatabaseAsync接口。
descriptions.en: After you register an SAP HANA instance and install a Cloud Backup client on the instance, you can call this operation to query the information about SAP HANA databases. You can call the StartHanaDatabaseAsync operation to start a database and call the StopHanaDatabaseAsync operation to stop a database.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun hbr describe-hana-databases --vault-id v-00063fq0000008xjr --cluster-id cl-000hpc000000uv14x --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --resource-group-id rg-acfmw2azsegupmi --region cn-hangzhou
